warnings: *** AXIS DECISION REVERSED 2026-07-25 -- BREAK LINE, NOT AN EXPANSION JOINT *** An earlier pass on this house read the double vertical line between grids ⑧ and ⑩ on S-01/S-02/S-03 as a structural expansion joint, concluded that grid ⑨ did not exist, and adopted a 10-line / 9-bay grid. THAT WAS WRONG. Re-examined at 4.5x magnification, the double line carries the standard ZIGZAG BREAK SYMBOL at mid-height: it is a drawing interruption, used on the 1:100 sheets to omit the repeating middle bays so the 36 m building fits the paper. Grid ⑨ is hidden inside the break, which is exactly why ⑧ and ⑩ appear adjacent and why 7→8 and 10→11 both still measure 3.60 m. E-02 (หน้า23, แปลนไฟฟ้าแสงสว่าง, 1:125) and A-03 (หน้า04, ผังบริเวณ, 1:125) are drawn at a smaller scale, fit the whole building without a break, and BOTH print the full axis 1..11 at a uniform 3.60 m with grid ⑨ present and ten ห้องนอน. THE CORRECT GRID IS 1..11, UNIFORM 3.60 m, 10 BAYS, 36.00 m OVERALL. Every sheet is consistent with this once the break is understood; nothing in the set actually conflicts. Consequence for this folder: element lists extracted from the 1:100 sheets record what is DRAWN (10 column lines), not the whole building (11). Grid-9 elements have been added by the repeating module and are flagged inferred_from_repeating_module.

GRID-9 ELEMENT ADDED 2026-07-25: one T1 truss at grid 9, flagged inferred_from_repeating_module. Total becomes 11 trusses, one per column line. NOTE the X-bracing bays were read as 1-3, 5-7 and 10-11 from the broken drawing; with the break understood, the panel east of the break may not be 10-11 -- that bay assignment is now less certain and is flagged.
Roof framing is a steel truss system: one T1 truss on every column line (10 total), แป 'A' purlins at 1.00 m spacing spanning between trusses, and rod X-bracing in selected panels.

BRACED PANELS: each braced panel spans TWO column bays, not one -- the diagonals run from grid 1 to grid 3 crossing at grid 2, and from grid 5 to grid 7 crossing at grid 6. Each is doubled vertically (one X in the ค-ข half, one in the ข-ก half), giving 6 braced panels in total including the 10-11 panel at the far end. Bays 3-4, 4-5 and 7-8 carry no bracing. This was read from the page-resolution scan plus one high-magnification crop of the left half; the 10-11 panel at the right end is the least certain and is flagged.

The 'รอยต่อเสา ดูแบบขยาย (ก)' callouts on this sheet point to S-07 (หน้า20), NOT S-06 -- confirmed 2026-07-25 by finding แบบขยาย (ก) drawn there.

NORMALIZED_2026-08-02: point-type grid refs were written with a dash (C-1). Schema section 4 reserves the dash for a RANGE only; a point is row+column with no dash (C1), which is what houses 01-05 use throughout. Only values under grid_ref/grid_ref_start/grid_ref_end/grid_refs were touched, so sheet_code (S-04) could not be hit.

pattern re-labelled 'etc_plan' -> 'roof_frame_plan' on 2026-08-28, closing the schema section-1 plan-family split (the split created beam_plan/footing_plan/roof_frame_plan but every legacy file had been bulk-renamed to etc_plan, which section 1 defines as the residual 'not a beam plan, not a footing plan, not a roof-framing plan'). Decided from what the sheet DRAWS -- discipline plus the element_type mix, with the view's own title as tie-breaker -- never from the filename alone. Reason: 18 roof-framing elements.
